allowed_actions.description: Allowlist of action identifiers permitted under this policy; empty means nothing is permitted by default (explicit deny-by-default)
allowed_actions.title: Allowed Actions

denied_actions.description: Explicit denylist; always takes precedence over allowed_actions
denied_actions.title: Denied Actions

require_range_ownership_token.description: If True, every action under this policy must present a valid range-ownership token proving the target environment is GhostRange-owned
require_range_ownership_token.title: Require Range Ownership Token
